description: Part I hashline eval corpus. Mirrors src/tests/test_hashline_gate.c. Each fixture is one edit task; the model must produce the edit under both the str_replace and hashline tool schemas. pass@1 = the resulting file equals `expected`.

fixtures.name: unique-line
fixtures.note: baseline single-line edit; both protocols should succeed

fixtures.name: duplicate-line
fixtures.note: identical lines: str_replace old_string is non-unique (occurs 2x)

fixtures.name: whitespace-recall
fixtures.note: model must recall exact indentation for str_replace; anchor does not

fixtures.name: middle-of-many
fixtures.initial:
l1
l2
l3
l4
l5
l6
fixtures.expected:
l1
l2
l3
L4
l5
l6

fixtures.name: whole-function
fixtures.note: whole-symbol rewrite: str_replace must echo the entire old body

fixtures.name: stale-drift
fixtures.note: file changes between read and edit; hashline must reject (not blind-apply)

gate.pass_at_1: hashline >= str_replace on every model; strictly better on local/open-weight delegates
gate.net_token_delta: report per-model total token delta (anchored-read overhead minus edit-block savings); require net-negative overall and never worse than +2% on any single model
gate.safety: no fixture may be silently mis-applied by hashline; drift must produce stale_anchor
